title: 1894 Sasun rebellion
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1894 Sasun rebellion", at revision 1370278941, opens: "The Sasun rebellion of 1894, also known as the First Sasun resistance, was the conflict between Ottoman Empire's Hamidiye forces and the Armenian fedayi belonging to the Armenian national movement's Hunchakian party in the Sasun region." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2047022, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Armenian uprising during the Ottoman Empire in 1894". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
